messages:
Maria: Heads-up — after v4.12 deploy I see p99 token latency ~2x on L4 nodes in euw2. CI perf job perf/l4-throughput failing.
Ben: Same here in canary. Throughput down ~18% (seq=256). Kernel planner is falling back to `matmul-generic` instead of `l4-opt` in the logs.
Ben: ```
[kernel-selector] chosen_kernel=l4-opt, shape=(8,256)
[kernel-selector] fallback_kernel=matmul-generic reason=shape_normalized
[perf] kvcache_evictions=325 -> 960
```
Carla: That matches PR #5123 (kernel-planner) that merged yesterday — it added shape-normalization. Maybe it's misclassifying padded vs true seqlen. @Ben @Maria
deploy-bot: Deploy v4.12 finished to euw2/usw2 (rollout-id: r-20260314-9a7). All canaries healthy at 10m.
Dan: I'm starting a quick bisect locally. First suspect = commit 9a7c3f (kernel-planner: shape normalization). Reproducer attached.
Maria: Reproducer command I used:
```
./scripts/perf_repro.sh --model=gpt-small --hardware=L4 --batch-sizes=8,16,32 --seq=256 --run=50
```
Maria: Observed kvcache_evictions x3 and fallback rate ~12%.
Emily: Flame profile (https://perf.company/reports/179345) shows generic GEMM time +40% after the change.
Ben: Quick hack: forcing `l4-opt` for known shapes brings throughput back to baseline in canary. Testing patch now.
Rebecca: Rolling partial rollback on euw2 L4 pool (taking canaries out of rotation). ETA 15m.
Maria: Canary measurements after revert: baseline restored. Need CI/regression test to catch kernel selection flips + kvcache eviction surge. Adding a perf assert.
Dan: Opened PR #5178 — adds kernel-selection unit in perf-tests and a kvcache eviction rate alert. Marking as rollout-blocker.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed in euw2 (deploy 4.12-rollback-1). Alerts cleared :white_check_mark:.
Maria: Follow-up action items: 1) Add kernel-selection unit tests for common shapes; 2) Add kvcache eviction >3x alert; 3) Add canary metric for fallback_rate>5%. I'll draft postmortem doc in /eng-runtime.
Ben: thx, filing test cases now. :thumbsup:
